fr.short: Autorisations granulaires définissant actions qu'une identité peut effectuer sur ressources spécifiques
fr.full:
Les **permissions** sont des autorisations granulaires définissant quelles actions (read, write, delete) une identité peut effectuer sur des ressources spécifiques.
**Modèles** : DAC (owner defines), MAC (centralized), RBAC (role-based), ABAC (attribute-based).
**Principes** : least privilege, separation of duties, deny by default, time-bound.
**Cloud IAM** : policies (JSON allow/deny), principals, actions, resources, conditions. **Problèmes** : permission creep, over-permissive. **Audit** : periodic reviews.

en.short: Granular authorizations defining the actions an identity can perform on specific resources
en.full:
**Permissions** are granular authorizations defining which actions (read, write, delete) an identity can perform on specific resources.
**Models**: DAC (owner defines), MAC (centralized), RBAC (role-based), ABAC (attribute-based).
**Principles**: least privilege, separation of duties, deny by default, time-bound.
**Cloud IAM**: policies (JSON allow/deny), principals, actions, resources, conditions. **Issues**: permission creep, over-permissive grants. **Audit**: periodic reviews.
